subject: using probit model with latent scores, need to get probabilities and latent scores as output

messages.author: faa4933e8dad78ce
messages.subject: using probit model with latent scores, need to get probabilities and latent scores as output
parts:
I am trying to estimate the following classification model, a latent variable is inducing for other correlated variables, at the same time latent variable is used in estimation of a binary classifier

I used ordered on d in the fit.

The fit is returning some results (with some warnings though). I need to get probabilities to estimate d (using probit ) I was thinking to use predict but that is giving all NA values. Estfun is not producing anything, though I am not sure what is that useful for even if it worked.

library(MASS)
set.seed(1)
mu <- rep(0,4)
Sigma <- matrix(.7, nrow=4, ncol=4) + diag(4)*.3
rawvars <- mvrnorm(n=1000, mu=mu, Sigma=Sigma)
d  <- as.ordered( as.numeric(rawvars[,1]>0) )
#
 df  <- data.frame(rawvars,d)

model  <- ' lat =~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X4
            d ~ lat
            lat ~~ 1*lat          '

> Ran it today again, go completely different result
The data is different:
and in the previous post:

Furthermore, estfun.lavaan() only works for estimator = "ML" and gives
you casewise 'scores' (=first derivatives). Why would you need that?

predict() gives you factor scores for the latent variable(s), not
probabilities.

Yves.
